title: What Limits Recursive Reasoning Models: Optimization, Architecture and Test-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2609.39967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursive reasoning models apply a small shared Transformer block many times to refine a latent state. This gives them large effective depth with few parameters and makes them strong on algorithmic tasks. Such compact solvers are natural candidates for tools that an LLM can call on narrow algorithmic subproblems. However, existing models such as HRM, TRM and URM differ in architecture, gradient propagation and training procedure simultaneously. This makes it hard to tell what drives their performance, and their optimization is still poorly understood and often unstable. In this work we address both of these gaps. First, we study these questions under a unified experimental pipeline spanning six algorithmic domains. Individual controlled ablations are performed on representative domains, while the resulting recipe is evaluated across the full suite. translated_title: 是什么限制了递归推理模型：优化、架构与测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 递归推理模型通过多次应用一个小型的共享Transformer块来细化潜在状态。这使它们以极少的参数获得很大的有效深度，并在算法任务上表现强大。这种紧凑的求解器是大语言模型（LLM）在处理窄域算法子问题时可调用的工具的天然候选。然而，现有模型如HRM、TRM和URM在架构、梯度传播和训练流程上同时存在差异，这使得难以判断究竟是什么驱动了它们的性能，而且它们的优化仍然知之甚少且常常不稳定。在这项工作中，我们解决了这两个空白。首先，我们在一个覆盖六个算法领域的统一实验流程下研究这些问题。在代表性领域上进行单独的受控消融实验，同时将所得到的方案在整个测试套件上进行评估。该研究揭示了一个令人惊讶的简单方案，可实现稳定且可泛化的递归推理。
tldr: 该论文在统一的实验流程下系统研究了优化、架构和测试时扩展如何影响递归推理模型（如HRM、TRM、URM）的性能，并通过受控消融实验揭示了一个实现稳定且可泛化递归推理的简单方案。
en_tdlr: Through a unified experimental pipeline with controlled ablations across six algorithmic domains, this paper systematically disentangles how optimization, architecture, and test-time scaling affect recursive reasoning models, revealing a surprisingly simple recipe for stable and generalizable recursive reasoning.
